changes: Name changed from 'Bhavahariśarman' to 'Bhavahari': the brahmin suffix śarman goes in titles only.
Title 'jyotiṣi' normalised to 'jyotiṣī' (the stem form of jyotiṣin, meaning astrologer).
Weekday given as 'Tuesday (roja 3)' instead of the bare 'roja 3'.

notes: The catalogue gives ŚS 1851, but the colophon reads śāke 1815. The catalogue figure is probably a transposed-digit typo. ŚS 1815 is about 1893 CE (Āśvina kṛṣṇa 8 falls around September/October 1893). 'roja 3' is read as the third day of the week, counting Sunday as 1, which makes it Tuesday.
